acceptance_gate_results.principle: Unavailable branch-local evidence never promotes readiness.
A producer repair must not erase the original disqualification.
Only owned current events can change current invocation counts.
Scripted and historical model-shaped bytes stay opaque to current provenance.
A permit is consumed before dispatch and every attempt becomes terminal.
A restart cannot replay a completed request as new work.
Cancellation releases only the fixture child owned by this control.
Readiness requires every scoped check and unchanged terminal reader.
CPU qualification cannot update weights, roll out, or publish externally.
